title: When the Echo Falls
author: Paloma Galloway
blurb: Sable Nakamura, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
